limitations: Concept-only review, not game integration, collision, native-grid, animation, physical safety or story-runtime validation.
Furniture and samples do not establish consent, actual payments, relocation, source disclosure or quest resolution.
Source appearance is not canon geography or a final identity/age model.

findings.finding: Three separate locked cabinets have distinguishable object/gear/head pictograms. Anonymous care room has its own open foreground doorway and street approach; opaque screen stands between doorway and chair, with side circulation. No patient, bed, readable identity or active fire appears. Screen sightlines at actual character height and cabinet access permissions remain untested. Closed folios and cabinets cannot prove source separation, authorized copies or actual care provision.

Detached broken and comparison samples remain outside the roped ruined arch. Ration counter faces the public foreground, independently of the rear empty meeting chair. Right-side bypass is visible; left side is partly curtained and narrower, so two equally broad ends are not established. No operating academy, attended meeting or allegiance is depicted. Empty chair does not grant political consent; bowls/tokens are decorative counts, not wages or rations already issued.

Original left foreground gate visibly blocks the sorting-yard opening. The right room has its own front and side exits. No visible flame, documents remain unreadable, covered brazier is separated by masonry. Prefer batch24/89_mae_fireless_sorting_attribution_review_v2.png for the left exit; retain original as history. Neither version establishes actual identity permissions, destruction, source correction or safe collision widths.

overall: 87/88 usable as review concepts with stated limits; original 89 gate issue resolved only by batch24 v2.
